title_en: RM2. 24 million worth of drugs seized in Sepang, Jeli
summary_en: SHAH ALAM – The Royal Malaysian Customs Department (JKDM) Selangor has thwarted attempted smuggling of ketamine and marijuana flowers worth more than RM2.24 million in two operations in Sepang and Kelantan last August and September, respectively. JKDM Selangor Director Noraidah Ishak said the drugs weighed all together 44.78 kilograms.
